Test Description: Verifies USB host-mode enumeration of a low-speed device through xHCI. Initializes PHY, configures port with wake enables, sets up DCBAA/Command Ring/Event Ring, starts host controller, detects port connect, performs port reset, issues Enable Slot and Address Device commands, and executes GET_DESCRIPTOR control transfer for device descriptor.
Remarks: Default_IRQHandler uses logical AND (&&) instead of bitwise AND (&). EP0 max packet size 8 bytes for low-speed. Three LSS SYSREG macros unresolved.
Test Steps / Procedure:
1. Initialize NIC and GIC interrupts
2. Configure USB2 PHY
3. Read host capability registers
4. Configure port wake enables
5. Set up DCBAA, Command Ring, Event Ring
6. Configure interrupter registers
7. Enable Slot Command and start host controller
8. Detect port connect, perform port reset
9. Set up Input Context, Address Device
10. Execute GET_DESCRIPTOR control transfer
11. Service interrupts via IRQ handler
Impacted Registers: GUSB2PHYCFG, HCSPARAMS1, SUPTPRT2_DW2, SUPTPRT3_DW2, PORTSC_20, DBOFF, CONFIG, DCBAAP_LO, DCBAAP_HI, CRCR_LO, CRCR_HI, ERSTSZ, ERDP_LO, ERDP_HI, ERSTBA_LO, ERSTBA_HI, IMOD, IMAN, USBCMD, USBSTS, DB
Validation / Acceptance Criteria:
1. Port connect detected after host start
2. Port reset completes successfully
3. Enable Slot and Address Device commands complete
4. GET_DESCRIPTOR returns device descriptor
5. All interrupts serviced correctly
6. GIC IRQ 84 cleared

Test Description: Verifies USB device-mode bulk data transfer at full-speed using DWC3. Initializes event buffer, configures device registers, sets up EP0 and EP1 (bulk) endpoints, performs control transfer setup and bulk data transfers with interrupt-driven completion.
Remarks: Debug marker 0xdeadbee5 at 0xA0243ffc. LSS SYSREG macros unresolved. IRQ handler uses logical AND (&&) instead of bitwise AND (&). +0x10 offset for EP1 endpoint.
Test Steps / Procedure:
1. Initialize NIC and GIC interrupts
2. Configure event buffer
3. Read global control and device config
4. Poll DSTS for microframe alignment
5. Configure device and enable endpoints
6. Configure USB2 PHY
7. Set up EP0 and EP1 (bulk) via DEPCMD
8. Execute control transfer setup
9. Perform bulk data transfers
10. Service interrupts via IRQ handler
Impacted Registers: GEVNTADRLO, GEVNTADRHI, GEVNTSIZ, GEVNTCOUNT, GCTL, DCFG, DSTS, DCTL, DALEPENA, GUSB2PHYCFG, DEPCMDPAR1, DEPCMDPAR0, DEPCMD
Validation / Acceptance Criteria:
1. Event buffer initialization successful
2. DSTS microframe alignment achieved
3. EP0 and EP1 endpoint commands complete
4. Bulk data transfer completes
5. All interrupts serviced
6. GIC IRQ 84 cleared
